targets.authors: Wicherts JM, Bakker M, Molenaar D.
targets.title: Willingness to Share Research Data Is Related to the Strength of the Evidence and the Quality of Reporting of Statistical Results.
targets.evidence_quote: In the second part of this paper, we describe our replication attempt, in which we studied the same hypotheses as Wicherts et al. [6], but with the data collected by Vanpaemel et al. [3].
targets.outcome_quote: Our replication study in the second part of this paper, however, failed to provide support for the hypotheses put forward by Wicherts et al. [6].
targets.outcome_computational_quote: First, we successfully reproduced the original results reported in Wicherts et al. [6], for both hypotheses.
targets.outcome_robustness_quote: However, the results for the first hypothesis were not robust against the choice of a standard variance estimator instead of a robust variance estimator in the negative binomial model. For the second hypothesis, the association between data sharing and decision errors was not robust against working with the number of decision errors instead of the presence of decision errors.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Replication verdict is explicitly failed. The paper also reproduces the same original: numerical reproduction succeeds, but alternative analyses challenge robustness; both axes are retained as supplementary fields for this mixed-design article.

reasoning: Both replication on a different sample and reproduction of original data are reported. Primary record type follows the replication aim and title; reproduction axes recorded on the same original. Vanpaemel supplies the new sample, and Nuijten supplies contextual comparisons and detection data; neither is itself a retested finding. Identity verified by title, DOI and author list.
